name: Renata Glasc
title: the Chem-Baroness

Q.name: Handshake
Q.description: Renata sends out a missile from her arm, Rooting the first enemy hit for 1 second and dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.8×AP magic damage. Recast: Renata Pulls the enemy in a direction, dealing 80/125/170/215/260 + 0.8×AP magic damage to enemies they are thrown into and Stunning for 0.5 seconds if the thrown enemy is a champion.
Q.summary: Renata sends out a missile rooting the first enemy hit, and can recast the ability to throw the unit in a direction.

W.name: Bailout
W.description: Renata infuses an ally champion, granting (10/15/20/25/30 + 0.01×AP) × 0.01 Attack Speed and (10/12.5/15/17.5/20 + 0.01×AP) × 0.01 Move Speed towards enemies, increasing to (10/15/20/25/30 + 0.01×AP) × 0.02 Attack Speed and (10/12.5/15/17.5/20 + 0.01×AP) × 0.02 Move Speed over 5 seconds. Takedowns refresh the duration of the buff. If the ally would die, they instead return to full Health, which then decays over 3 seconds. If they get a Takedown while decaying, they will be set to 20% max Health and stop decaying. The Champion's death can be delayed by healing or similar effects while in the decaying state, but cannot be prevented unless the Champion gets a Takedown. Champions can only delay their death once.
W.summary: Renata buffs an allied champion to fight harder, delaying their death and potentially saving them if they get a takedown.

E.name: Loyalty Program
E.description: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, dealing 65/95/125/155/185 + 0.55×AP magic damage and Slowing surrounding enemies and enemies hit by 30% for 2 seconds. Allies hit gain 50/65/80/95/110 + 0.5×AP Shield for 3 seconds.
E.summary: Renata sends out a pair of chemtech missiles, shielding allies and damaging and slowing enemies hit.

R.name: Hostile Takeover
R.description: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, Berserking enemies for 1.25/1.75/2.25 seconds, causing them to Attack the nearest unit, prioritizing their allies. While Berserk, enemies gain 100% Attack Speed.
R.summary: Renata sends out a wave of chemicals, causing any enemies hit to go Berserk.

Passive.name: Leverage
Passive.description: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.
Passive.summary: Renata's Attacks deal bonus damage and mark enemies. Renata's allies can damage marked enemies to deal bonus damage.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Renata Glasc is an enchanter support who roots enemies with Handshake and saves allies with Bailout. She plays support, turning teamfights with Hostile Takeover's berserk.
strengths: Handshake roots and then pulls the target into allies, stunning both champions.
Bailout saves allies from death briefly, returning them to full health that then decays.
Hostile Takeover berserks enemies, making them attack their own allies.
Loyalty Program slows enemies and shields allies.
Leverage passive marks enemies for bonus ally damage.
weaknesses: Weak early: low damage and squishy.
Handshake is a skillshot; missing it leaves her with no CC.
Bailout only saves allies who can get a kill or escape before it decays.

curve.lvl1: okay – Q root is her only threat
curve.lvl2: good – Q root plus E slow sets up her ADC
curve.lvl3: good – W Bailout saves her ADC in all-ins
curve.lvl6: very strong – Hostile Takeover berserks the enemy into hitting each other
curve.items: weak – first item: Moonstone Renewer or Shurelya's Battlesong

profile.curveNote: Renata is strongest at 6 with Hostile Takeover, and her W makes teamfights much safer.
profile.waveClear: Low: she should not push waves.

keyAbilities.answers: None. Renata has no spell shield or dodge.

Passive.notes: Leverage: her attacks mark enemies, and allies deal bonus damage to marked targets.

Q.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block; Cleanse/QSS removes the root.
Q.notes: Handshake: roots the first enemy hit; recast pulls/throws them, stunning champions they hit.

W.notes: Bailout: attack and move speed for an ally; if they would die, they return to full health that decays unless they get a takedown.

E.answer: Dodge sideways, or block with a projectile block.
E.notes: Loyalty Program: missiles that slow enemies and shield allies.

R.answer: Dodge sideways or stand away from her; berserk is not immobilizing.
R.notes: Hostile Takeover: a wave that berserks enemies, making them attack nearby units, prioritising their allies.

profile.windowAgainst: Renata's window is before 6 or when Handshake is on cooldown: she can't stop an all-in.
